articles.title: Bitcoin firms ask AI labs for same tools attackers already have
articles.snippet: Coinbase, Block, BitGo and dozens of others signed a letter arguing that safety guardrails on frontier models are blocking legitimate security work while adversaries face no such limits.

articles.title: Trezor Customer Data Exposed in Shipping Partner Breach
articles.snippet: The hardware wallet manufacturer says its devices and backups are untouched, but the leak hands attackers valuable customer data.

articles.title: XRP Bridge Drained After Software Treats Fake Deposits as Real
articles.snippet: A flaw that went undetected during multiple audits allowed an attacker to create unbacked balances and withdraw XRP from the bridge’s reserves.

articles.title: Harmony's ONE Sinks 37% After Attacker Mints 4 Billion Tokens
articles.snippet: The team is weighing a rollback, which would undo the attack along with every legitimate transaction made since.

articles.title: BTCPay Backers Offer Bitcoin Bounty After Wallet Exploit
articles.snippet: The reward aims to recover Bitcoin stolen after attackers gained access to connected LND wallets.
